scholarly_quality.concise_summary: OmniScientist presents a substantial, well-formulated, and thoroughly evaluated architecture for autonomous scientific research. The integration of deterministic, programmatic verification gates effectively addresses common pitfalls in LLM-based science (such as p-hacking, hallucinated metrics, and lack of raw data grounding), backed by solid empirical validation across 36 distinct real-world datasets.

together with the raw artifacts referenced by that specification. OmniScientist coordinates a perception layer
with 3 autonomous agents for ideation, experiment, and writeup (Figure 3). Within each stage, a ReAct loop
interleaves observation, reasoning, and action (Yao et al., 2023; Shinn et al., 2023; Schick et al., 2023), allowing
evidence to shape question formation, experimental design, result inspection, and scientific argumentation.

when an experiment collapses or yields a null result, and admits each stage output only after a check enforced

validity (Algorithm 1). The check grounds the experiment in reality by confirming that the agent genuinely
accessed the requested dataset and generated figures matching the raw execution trace. To prevent statistical
manipulation,thesystemenforcesastrictmultiple-comparisoncorrectionthataccountsforeverytestattempted
duringthedebuggingloop, whichpreventsartificialreductionsinthecorrectiondenominator. Italsoappliesa
post-hoc rescue guard to ensure headline findings originate from primary tests, runs an independence check to
eliminate circular predictions, and relegates any unsupported analyses to the execution trace. Figure 5 places
this check and the later claim check in sequence, both auditing against the same execution record rather than
against the text the agent wrote.

panel (deepseek-v4-flash and gemini-2.5-flash-lite) over the entire case suite. For these evaluations, the framework and perception

over successfully scored papers. The highest value in each column is highlighted, and coverage per backbone is detailed in Table 4.
Notably, clarity exhibits the least degradation, whereas factual accuracy and soundness most closely track the underlying backbone
strength.

missing_information: No reproducible review or selection methodology was detected.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: The headline outcome is established by a two-judge cross-family panel (deepseek-v4-flash and gemini-2.5-flash-lite) scoring compiled manuscripts on a 7-dimension rubric, with inter-judge agreement at Krippendorff alpha 0.66 and verbosity bias at rho 0.16; the optimization signal is the internal deterministic code checks and ReAct loop feedback, which are materially separate from the external judges.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: External automated scoring by a two-judge cross-family panel (deepseek-v4-flash and gemini-2.5-flash-lite) over a 7-dimensional rubric, plus objective case-study metrics such as AUC and Cohen's d.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Internal deterministic Python predicates (provenance, multiple-comparison correction, schema validity) and ReAct loop feedback.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Reported claims of cross-disciplinary execution, traceability, and perceptual advantages are corroborated by comprehensive evaluation scores, execution trace audits, and detailed case studies in seismology and pediatric chest radiology.
primary.evaluation_assessment: Evaluation spans 36 diverse scientific datasets across 5 disciplines, testing 9 distinct reasoning backbones and utilizing cross-family LLM judges (DeepSeek-v4-Flash and Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite). Ablation studies isolate the impact of multimodal perception against a blind scalar baseline (demonstrating an 85% win rate), as well as the independent contributions of literature search, agentic looping, and automated checks.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: The headline evaluation relies on independent cross-family LLM judges evaluating compiled manuscripts, validated by Krippendorff alpha (0.66) and verbosity checks, as well as verifiable statistical measurements on real scientific data.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: External automated scoring by a two-judge cross-family panel (DeepSeek-v4-Flash and Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite) over a 7-dimensional rubric, alongside objective case-study metrics (e.g., AUC, Cohen's d).
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Internal deterministic code checks (Python predicates for stdout provenance, multiple testing corrections, and schema validity) and ReAct loop feedback.

primary.limitations: The work notes that open-weight smaller models degrade significantly in sound hypothesis generation and factual accuracy, while the pipeline requires bounded step budgets and relies on external LLM judges for rubric-based scoring.
primary.method_assessment: OmniScientist structures discovery across ideation, experiment, and writeup agents managed by an outer deterministic pipeline rather than unstructured agent dialogue. Rigor is maintained via explicit programmatic constraints including mandatory multiple-comparison corrections over all attempted executions, verification of real stdout execution against reported numbers, anti-HARKing lead selection, and guarded writeup compilation.
primary.quality_rationale: OmniScientist presents a substantial, well-formulated, and thoroughly evaluated architecture for autonomous scientific research. The integration of deterministic, programmatic verification gates effectively addresses common pitfalls in LLM-based science (such as p-hacking, hallucinated metrics, and lack of raw data grounding), backed by solid empirical validation across 36 distinct real-world datasets.
primary.scoped_contribution: The paper introduces OmniScientist, an end-to-end multi-agent framework designed to automate scientific discovery directly from raw multimodal data across four evidence families (perceptual, symbolic, quantitative-statistical, procedural). The framework enforces rigor through deterministic, code-based gates (idea, rigour, and claim checks) to guarantee provenance, numerical traceability, and statistical validity across a 36-case demonstration suite.

scholarly_quality.rationale: OmniScientist presents a substantial, well-formulated, and thoroughly evaluated architecture for autonomous scientific research. The integration of deterministic, programmatic verification gates effectively addresses common pitfalls in LLM-based science (such as p-hacking, hallucinated metrics, and lack of raw data grounding), backed by solid empirical validation across 36 distinct real-world datasets.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The work notes that open-weight smaller models degrade significantly in sound hypothesis generation and factual accuracy, while the pipeline requires bounded step budgets and relies on external LLM judges for rubric-based scoring.

limitations_or_uncertainty.value: Structured research-card claims use title, abstract/summary, metadata, screening rules, and curation. A separate scholarly-quality assessment used bounded full-text excerpts, but unsupported claim, method, or evidence fields remain unextracted.
